brief:
Hamas said Israeli targeting of Palestinian journalists, media workers and news organizations constitutes war crimes and crimes against humanity that do not expire, Shehab Wire reported. The movement called for international media organizations to protect what it termed "knights of truth" and demanded accountability for the occupation's actions.

The statement addressed systematic attacks on the Palestinian press, characterizing them as violations of international humanitarian law that warrant prosecution before international courts.

title: Hamas calls for protection of journalists and prosecution of Israeli occupation
